name: Admin Maintenance Message
author: Andreas Grzybowski

sections.description:
An always-visible admin notice to inform all users about maintenance windows. Configure under Settings → Wartungshinweis.

Features
* Checkbox “Maintenance active”
* From/To (datetime-local, uses WP timezone)
* Free text with placeholders {DATE}, {FROM}, {TO}, {TZ}, {WEEKDAY}, {DATE_TO}, {WEEKDAY_TO}, {DATETIME_FROM}, {DATETIME_TO}
* Non-dismissible banner on all admin screens
* Multisite-safe uninstall
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder admin-maintenance-msg to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings → Wartungshinweis.
